modalities.evidence: bilateral force plates measuring three-dimensional forces

output.population: 59 healthy adults with a mean age of 24 ± 5 years, representing both sexes and different body mass index categories
output.summary: Treadmill walking recordings at three controlled speeds combining scalp EEG, surface EMG of lower-limb muscles, inertial kinematics and force plate ground reaction data, supporting study of brain-body interactions during gait.
